package.name: slamko_tsdf
package.description: slamko volumetric layer: a dense map that BENDS with the pose-graph (per-keyframe depth source re-integrated at corrected poses — PLVS/RTAB on-demand assembly, not nvblox_submap's rigid anchor) and exports a 2D costmap/ESDF for global A→B planning. Backend pluggable behind the slamko_core VolumetricBackend contract; nvblox (GPU TSDF→ESDF) is the first impl, gated by -DSLAMKO_WITH_NVBLOX so the workspace builds CUDA-free. Depends on slamko_core contracts only (Hard Rule #2). Apache-2.0. See docs/PLAN_SLAMKO_TSDF_01.md.
